content.text:
The robot is resting, facing the red ball, which is a few centimeters in front of its feet.

- **Finding it:** I couldn't see the ball from the start. I walked into the open floor and, after getting around a black case, spotted it about 3 m away near the office chair and the TV stand.
- **The wrong turn:** When I walked toward it, I lost sight of it and stopped at the TV stand. The ball wasn't anywhere ahead, so I turned around and found it right at my feet. I most likely walked past it or nudged it as I went.
- **Final position:** I made a small turn to face it, and the bottom camera showed it centered just ahead. Crouching into rest twisted the body about 9°, but the ball is still visible straight ahead at the bottom of the frame.

There were no falls. The battery is at 60% and not charging.
